decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 141 Firs Drive.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western wall of the extension and no additional openings shall be formed in any wall of the structure at rear hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The single storey detached building for which permission is hereby granted shall not be occupied or let as a separate dwelling but shall be used only for purposes ancilliary to the use of the single family dwelling house on the site
description: Demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey rear and flank & front extensions, front entrance porch to dwellinghouse and erection of single building for use as garage/shed at the end of the rear garden
